text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting emails or checking data. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools that help workers plan their day, organize meetings, and write reports faster. However, AI does not replace people completely. In most companies, humans and AI work together. For example, AI can suggest ideas, and people decide what is best. Because of these changes, some jobs are different now, and workers need new skills. Learning to use AI tools is becoming important for almost everyone.
